data.name: Khairul
data.gender_notes: Khairul is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Khaira', meaning 'to flourish or prosper'. It symbolizes the radiant and beautiful nature of the individual, and is believed to offer protection and blessings for a prosperous life. The name Khairul carries the meaning “The Radiant One” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Bengali, Malay. Parents who choose Khairul usually hope their child will grow to embody the radiant one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
